_comment_auditBranch: The branch `lightbox handover` looks for in each project when listing the fix commits above its base. Override per run with --branch.
_comment_scan: Point at a directory and lightbox works out what is in it: package.json decides the runner, an .html file makes it a static site, anything else is skipped. depth 2 also looks one level into apps/ and packages/ for monorepos.
_comment_projects: Explicit entries win over anything scanned with the same key. Use them to name a project properly, group it, pin its review port, list the routes that should lead, or fill in dynamic segments.
_comment_kind: Set "kind": "static" on a directory that carries a package.json but is really plain HTML, so lightbox serves the files instead of trying to start a dev server.
_comment_command: Set "command" when the runner is not next, vite, astro, nuxt, remix or cra: an argv array (or one string) with {port} substituted. The first word is resolved from node_modules/.bin.
